seasonal_profile.note: Typical values are medians across years for months with at least 20 days of record.

current_vs_historical.note: At least two earlier years covering the same window are needed; extend the history period.

change_points.note: Change-point detection needs at least 36 months of record.

calibration.note: Four-Witness harmonization: Prior from Li et al. (2020): 50% MODIS detection at ~4.3 MW at nadir, ~31.7 MW at the scan edge. Too few Aqua/S-NPP matchups in this area to learn a regional profile.

detection_profile.note: Prior from Li et al. (2020): 50% MODIS detection at ~4.3 MW at nadir, ~31.7 MW at the scan edge. Too few Aqua/S-NPP matchups in this area to learn a regional profile.
detection_profile.viirs_noaa_treatment: NOAA-20 and NOAA-21 share the S-NPP VIIRS profile after time-of-day correction.

diurnal.source: default afternoon-peaking curve (too few detections to fit)
diurnal.note: Each observation is scaled by f(13:30)/f(its real local time), capped at 4x, which also removes the overpass-drift artifacts of Terra and Aqua. Himawari diurnal cycles are not connected (no public fire API).

effort.method: Expected looks = swath width / ground-track spacing at the AOI latitude, for the day and night pass, times the clear-sky fraction. Daily observation masks (MOD14A1/MYD14A1/VNP14A1/VJ114A1) need an Earthdata login and are not connected.
effort.cloud_source: ERA5 daily mean cloud cover at the AOI centre

tiers.consistent_record: MODIS-level sensitivity in Aqua 13:30 equivalent detections per clear look: MODIS daytime detections (duplicates removed) plus VIIRS daytime clusters weighted by the chance MODIS would have seen them.
tiers.detailed_layer: Every VIIRS 375 m detection (day and night) per clear VIIRS look; drives the globe and live hotspots.

fusion.method: Occupancy-style update per 0.1 deg cell and local day: start from the cell's historical burning rate for that month (shrunk to the area rate), add log(p_detect / false-alarm) for each witness that detected and log((1 - p_detect)^looks) for each clear miss; cloudy looks are not counted.

summary.local_day: Days are local solar days (UTC + longitude / 15).

hide_one_witness.note: Suomi NPP VIIRS has no detections in this area and period.

labels.valid_no_fire: Valid observation with no detected fire

observation_quality.method: Sensor availability from FIRMS archive date ranges and fetch results; cloud cover from ERA5 reanalysis daily mean at the AOI centroid (proxy, not a satellite cloud mask).

trend.method: Theil–Sen median slope; at least four complete years required.

reliability.label: limited
reliability.method: Sensor availability from FIRMS archive date ranges and fetch results; cloud cover from ERA5 reanalysis daily mean at the AOI centroid (proxy, not a satellite cloud mask).

fire_dna.summary: Between 2025 and 2026, this region typically experienced its highest satellite-detected hotspot activity during Jan. The comparable long-term trend was insufficient data. Data reliability was limited; cloud cover, satellite availability and sensor sensitivity can limit interpretation.
fire_dna.method: Monthly reference values are medians of months with at least 20 record days. Annual comparisons require all 12 such months. Peak season is the longest circular run at or above the 75th percentile monthly median.

provenance.grid: 0.1 deg (~11 km) cells on local solar days for the consistent record and fused probability; 0.01 deg footprint-weighted cells for active-cell counts
provenance.harmonization: Four-Witness harmonization: Prior from Li et al. (2020): 50% MODIS detection at ~4.3 MW at nadir, ~31.7 MW at the scan edge. Too few Aqua/S-NPP matchups in this area to learn a regional profile.
provenance.harmonized_unit: Aqua MODIS 13:30-equivalent detections per clear-sky look
provenance.anomaly_method: Robust z = (x - median) / (1.4826 * MAD) against the same +/-7-day window in other years (>= 3 years), else a rolling 31-day window.
provenance.cloud_cover: ERA5 daily mean via Open-Meteo at AOI centre (23.81, 90.41); ok
